articles.title_en: Capitalism and extreme poverty: A global analysis of real wages, human height, and mortality since the long 16th century
articles.title_cn: 资本主义与极端贫困：自16世纪以来实际工资、人类身高和死亡率的全球分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper assesses claims that, prior to the 19th century, around 90% of the human population lived in extreme poverty (defined as the inability to access essential goods), and that global human welfare only began to improve with the rise of capitalism. These claims rely on national accounts and PPP exchange rates that do not adequately capture changes in people’s access to essential goods. We assess this narrative against extant data on three empirical indicators of human welfare: real wages (with respect to a subsistence basket), human height, and mortality. We ask whether these indicators improved or deteriorated with the rise of capitalism in five world regions - Europe, Latin America, sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia and China – using the chronology put forward by world-systems theorists. The evidence we review here points to three conclusions. (1) It is unlikely that 90% of the human population lived in extreme poverty prior to the 19th century. Historically, unskilled urban labourers in all regions tended to have wages high enough to support a family of four above the poverty line by working 250 days or 12 months a year, except during periods of severe social dislocation, such as famines, wars, and institutionalized dispossession – particularly under colonialism. (2) The rise of capitalism caused a dramatic deterioration of human welfare. In all regions studied here, incorporation into the capitalist world-system was associated with a decline in wages to below subsistence, a deterioration in human stature, and an upturn in premature mortality. In parts of South Asia, sub-Saharan Africa, and Latin America, key welfare metrics have still not recovered. (3) Where progress has occurred, significant improvements in human welfare began several centuries after the rise of capitalism. In the core regions of Northwest Europe, progress began in the 1880s, while in the periphery and semi-periphery it began in the mid-20th century, a period characterized by the rise of anti-colonial and socialist political movements that redistributed incomes and established public provisioning systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了以下主张：在19世纪之前，约90%的人类人口生活在极端贫困中（定义为无法获得基本商品），并且全球人类福利仅随着资本主义的兴起而开始改善。这些主张依赖于国民账户和购买力平价汇率，而这些并未充分捕捉人们获取基本商品的变化。我们根据人类福利的三个经验指标——实际工资（相对于生存篮子）、人类身高和死亡率——的现有数据来评估这一叙事。我们询问这些指标在资本主义兴起时是否改善或恶化，涉及五个世界区域——欧洲、拉丁美洲、撒哈拉以南非洲、南亚和中国——使用世界体系理论家提出的时间顺序。我们在此回顾的证据指向三个结论。（1）在19世纪之前，约90%的人类人口生活在极端贫困中是不太可能的。历史上，所有地区的非熟练城市劳动者往往有足够高的工资，通过每年工作250天或12个月，能够养活一个四口之家在贫困线以上，除非在严重社会动荡时期，如饥荒、战争和制度化剥夺——特别是在殖民主义下。（2）资本主义的兴起导致了人类福利的急剧恶化。在我们研究的所有区域，融入资本主义世界体系与工资降至生存水平以下、人类身高下降以及过早死亡率上升相关。在南亚、撒哈拉以南非洲和拉丁美洲的部分地区，关键福利指标至今仍未恢复。（3）在取得进展的地方，人类福利的显著改善始于资本主义兴起几个世纪之后。在西北欧的核心区域，进步始于1880年，而在边缘和半边缘地区，则始于20世纪中叶，这一时期的特点是反殖民和社会主义政治运动的兴起，这些运动重新分配了收入并建立了公共供给体系。

articles.title_en: Radio and technology adoption during India’s Green Revolution: Evidence from a natural experiment
articles.title_cn: 印度绿色革命期间的广播与技术采用：来自自然实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Can mass communication play a role in spurring technology adoption and productivity growth in agriculture, particularly when there are significant barriers to social learning? To answer this question, I estimate the impact of regional radio broadcasts, that included significant farm programming, on the adoption of high-yielding varieties (HYVs) of rice and wheat during the Green Revolution in India. I exploit the staggered expansion of the regional radio network to identify the impact. Using an annual district-level administrative dataset from 1966 to 1978, I find that introduction of regional farm radio broadcasts led to a large persistent increase in the adoption of HYVs of rice, a spatially heterogeneous technology less amenable to social learning. By contrast, there was at most a transient impact on the adoption of HYVs of wheat, a spatially homogeneous technology with a lot of scope for social learning. Importantly, I find that the regional farm radio broadcasts increased rice yields by 15%, a magnitude potentially large enough to justify the investments in the expansion of the regional radio network. Overall, this paper demonstrates that mass communication can indeed play a key role in diffusing profitable agricultural innovations when there are significant barriers to social learning.
articles.abstract_cn: 大众传播能否在促进农业技术采用和生产率增长方面发挥作用，尤其是在存在显著社会学习障碍的情况下？为回答这一问题，我估算了包含大量农业节目的区域广播对印度绿色革命期间水稻和小麦高产品种采用的影响。我利用区域广播网络的分阶段扩展来识别影响。使用1966年至1978年的年度区级行政数据集，我发现区域农业广播的引入导致水稻高产品种采用率大幅持续增加，水稻是一种空间异质性技术，不太适合社会学习。相比之下，对小麦高产品种采用的影响至多是短暂的，小麦是一种空间同质性技术，社会学习空间很大。重要的是，我发现区域农业广播使水稻产量增加了15%，这一幅度可能足以证明区域广播网络扩展投资的合理性。总体而言，本文表明，当存在显著的社会学习障碍时，大众传播确实可以在传播有利可图的农业创新方面发挥关键作用。

articles.title_en: Community enforcement and tenure security: A fuzzy-set qualitative Comparative analysis of twelve community forest management initiatives in the Peruvian Amazon
articles.title_cn: 社区执法与保有权保障：秘鲁亚马逊地区十二个社区森林管理倡议的模糊集定性比较分析
articles.abstract_en: The interest of policymakers in community management of tropical forests is ever growing. Yet, a large research body shows varied levels of success of community conservation initiatives. While policymakers often prioritize legal forest ownership, mostly land titles, consensus exists that success rather depends on a broader set of local institutional arrangements and their fit with the forest context. In this paper, we contribute to building theory on these institutional arrangements and their interaction. We apply a fuzzy set Qualitative Comparative Analysis to case study data on 12 voluntary community conservation initiatives in northern Peru to explore the relationship between local enforcement, legal and alternative property rights, and conservation effectiveness. As recommended for QCA our case selection was intentional and the cases exhibit diverse conservation successes, geographic characteristics, legal and customary property rights, and enforcement mechanisms. We conclude that strong community enforcement mechanisms are indispensable for effective conservation in voluntary initiatives. Furthermore, we find for cases with strong enforcement mechanisms, that some government back-up, i.e., local government support for enforcement and/or legal rights to conserve the forest, significantly increases conservation effectiveness. Strong conservation enforcement tends to be present in communities with strong forest rules, leaders, and pre-existing community institutions. Our findings suggest the importance of paying close attention to community characteristics during project design and refraining from one-size-fits-all-solutions, such as focusing mainly on the presence of legal ownership rights over the forest. Instead, more focus needs to be placed on understanding existing community institutions and supporting communities to strengthen and adapt these for conservation enforcement, rather than imposing new arrangements. Finally, policymakers can help community enforcement institutions become even more effective, by providing them with legal rights to conserve the forest and by strengthening their relationship with local governments so that they receive support in situations they struggle to handle alone.
articles.abstract_cn: 政策制定者对热带森林社区管理的兴趣日益增长。然而，大量研究显示社区保护倡议的成功程度不一。虽然政策制定者通常优先考虑法定森林所有权，主要是土地所有权，但共识认为成功更依赖于更广泛的地方制度安排及其与森林背景的契合度。在本文中，我们致力于构建关于这些制度安排及其相互作用的理论。我们将模糊集定性比较分析应用于秘鲁北部12个自愿社区保护倡议的案例研究数据，以探讨地方执法、法定和替代性产权与保护有效性之间的关系。按照QCA的建议，我们的案例选择是有意的，案例展示了不同的保护成功程度、地理特征、法定和习惯产权以及执法机制。我们得出结论，强有力的社区执法机制对于自愿倡议中的有效保护不可或缺。此外，我们发现对于具有强执法机制的案例，一些政府支持，即地方政府对执法的支持和/或保护森林的法定权利，显著提高了保护有效性。强有力的保护执法往往存在于具有强森林规则、领导者和既有社区制度的社区中。我们的研究结果表明，在项目设计期间密切关注社区特征的重要性，并避免一刀切的解决方案，例如主要关注森林法定所有权的存在。相反，需要更多地关注理解现有社区制度，并支持社区加强和调整这些制度以用于保护执法，而不是强加新的安排。最后，政策制定者可以通过赋予社区保护森林的法定权利，并加强其与地方政府的关系，使他们在独自难以处理的情况下获得支持，从而帮助社区执法机构变得更加有效。

articles.title_en: Explaining trends in adult height in China: 1950 to 1990
articles.title_cn: 解释中国成年人身高的变化趋势：1950年至1990年
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the changing trend of adult height in China for cohorts born in 1950–90. We use information on household structure and local economic conditions during the individual’s childhood to explain the trend. We find that during the 40-year period, the growth rate of adult height increased, with the most substantial increase occurring in the 1980s. One important contributing factor to the growth of adult height is the continued increase in government per capita spending on health and education. The impressive growth in the 1980s was mainly due to the introduction of market-oriented economic reforms, rather than the advent of the One-Child Policy. We find that the positive effect of economic reforms was larger for urban dwellers than for their rural counterparts and within the rural areas the benefit was far greater for men than for women.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了1950-90年出生队列中国成年人身高的变化趋势。我们利用个体童年时期的家庭结构和当地经济状况信息来解释这一趋势。我们发现，在这40年期间，成年人身高的增长速度有所提高，其中增长最显著的是在1980年。促进成年人身高增长的一个重要因素是政府在人均卫生和教育支出上的持续增加。1980年的显著增长主要归因于市场化经济改革的引入，而非独生子女政策的实施。我们发现，经济改革的积极影响在城市居民中大于农村居民，而在农村地区，男性受益远大于女性。

articles.title_en: Using machine learning and qualitative interviews to design a five-question survey module for women’s agency
articles.title_cn: 利用机器学习和定性访谈设计一个包含五个问题的女性自主权调查模块
articles.abstract_en: Open-ended interview questions elicit rich information about people’s lives, but in large-scale surveys, social scientists often need to measure complex concepts using only a few close-ended questions. We propose a new method to design a short survey measure for such cases by combining mixed-methods data collection and machine learning. We identify the best survey questions based on how well they predict a benchmark measure of the concept derived from qualitative interviews. We apply the method to create a survey module and index for women’s agency. We measure agency for 209 married women in Haryana, India, first, through a semi-structured interview and, second, through a large set of close-ended questions. We use qualitative coding methods to score each woman’s agency based on the interview, which we use as a benchmark measure of agency. To determine the close-ended questions most predictive of the benchmark, we apply statistical algorithms that build on LASSO and random forest but constrain how many variables are selected for the model (five in our case). The resulting five-question index is as strongly correlated with the coded qualitative interview as is an index that uses all of the candidate questions. This approach of selecting survey questions based on their statistical correspondence to coded qualitative interviews could be used to design short survey modules for many other latent constructs.
articles.abstract_cn: 开放式访谈问题能引出关于人们生活的丰富信息，但在大规模调查中，社会科学家往往需要用少数封闭式问题来衡量复杂概念。我们提出了一种新方法，通过结合混合方法数据收集和机器学习，为此类情况设计简短的调查测量工具。我们根据调查问题对从定性访谈中得出的概念基准测量的预测效果，来识别最佳调查问题。我们将该方法应用于创建女性自主权的调查模块和指数。我们首先通过半结构化访谈，其次通过大量封闭式问题，测量了印度哈里亚纳邦209名已婚女性的自主权。我们使用定性编码方法，根据访谈对每位女性的自主权进行评分，并将其作为自主权的基准测量。为了确定对基准最具预测性的封闭式问题，我们应用了基于LASSO和随机森林的统计算法，但限制了模型选择的变量数量（在我们的案例中为五个）。由此产生的五问题指数与编码后的定性访谈的相关性，与使用所有候选问题的指数一样强。这种根据调查问题与编码定性访谈的统计对应性来选择调查问题的方法，可用于设计许多其他潜在构念的简短调查模块。

articles.title_en: Disease and diversity in long-term economic development
articles.title_cn: 长期经济发展中的疾病与多样性
articles.abstract_en: Ethnographic data and archeological censuses of cities suggest that sub-Saharan Africa lagged behind tropical America during pre-colonial times. Disease (i.e., environmentally determined pathogen stress) has a negative impact on pre-colonial economic conditions, as measured by the presence of large physical structures in ethnographic data. This negative relationship is seen primarily, but not exclusively in African societies. Using a simple coalitional game, I propose a causal path from disease to ethnic diversity. Ethnographic data suggests a positive effect of disease on ethnic diversity, and persistent effects on long-term economic development. Even today, pre-colonial factors influence income per capita and ethnolinguistic fractionalization.
articles.abstract_cn: 民族志数据和城市考古普查表明，在前殖民时期，撒哈拉以南非洲落后于热带美洲。疾病（即环境决定的病原体压力）对前殖民时期的经济状况有负面影响，这通过民族志数据中大型实体结构的存在来衡量。这种负面关系主要但并非 exclusively 出现在非洲社会中。使用一个简单的联盟博弈，我提出了从疾病到民族多样性的因果路径。民族志数据表明疾病对民族多样性有正向影响，并对长期经济发展有持续影响。即使在今天，前殖民时期的因素仍影响人均收入和民族语言分裂。

articles.title_en: Refugees welcome? Inter-group interaction and host community attitude formation
articles.title_cn: 欢迎难民？群体间互动与东道社区态度形成
articles.abstract_en: Building upon the literature on attitudes to immigration, which mainly focuses on Europe and North America, this article explores the role of inter-group interaction in influencing host community attitudes towards refugees in East Africa. It draws upon first-hand quantitative (n = 16,608) and qualitative data collected from refugees and nearby host communities in urban and camp-like contexts in Uganda, Kenya, and Ethiopia. Focusing on the Uganda data, for which host community attitude and interaction data is available, OLS regressions reveal a small positive and significant correlation between refugee-host interaction and the perception of hosts towards refugees. This association disappears when an instrumental variable (IV) approach is used to address endogeneity issues, except when only data from the urban context is used. Combining cross-country data and qualitative data, we highlight some conditions that may shape hosts’ attitudes towards refugees, including the types of interaction, ethno-linguistic proximity, and residence in urban or camp-like contexts. In all contexts, an important part of attitude formation appears to take place at the intra-group level, within households and immediate neighbourhoods, independently of individual interaction with the out-group.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于主要关注欧洲和北美的移民态度文献，本文探讨了群体间互动在东非东道社区对难民态度形成中的作用。本文利用了从乌干达、肯尼亚和埃塞俄比亚的城市和类似营地环境中收集的难民及邻近东道社区的第一手定量（n = 16,608）和定性数据。聚焦于乌干达数据，该数据提供了东道社区态度和互动信息，OLS回归显示难民与东道社区互动与东道社区对难民的感知之间存在小而显著的正相关。当使用工具变量（IV）方法处理内生性问题时，这种关联消失，除非仅使用城市背景的数据。结合跨国数据和定性数据，我们强调了可能塑造东道社区对难民态度的若干条件，包括互动类型、民族语言接近性以及居住在城市或类似营地环境中。在所有背景下，态度形成的重要部分似乎发生在群体内部层面，即在家庭和邻近社区内部，独立于与外群体的个体互动。

articles.title_en: Accelerating technical change through ICT: Evidence from a video-mediated extension experiment in Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 通过信息通信技术加速技术变革：来自埃塞俄比亚视频中介推广实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Despite enthusiasm around applications of information and communications technologies (ICTs) to smallholder agriculture in many lower-income countries, there are still many questions on the effectiveness of ICT-based approaches. This study assesses the impacts of video-mediated agricultural extension service provision on farmers’ adoption of improved agricultural technologies and practices in Ethiopia using data from a two-year randomized experiment. Our results show that the video-mediated extension approach significantly increases uptake of recommended technologies and practices by improving extension access and farmer knowledge. Specifically, we find that video-mediated extension reaches a wider audience than the government’s conventional extension approach and leads to higher levels of farmer understanding and uptake of the subject technologies in those locations randomly assigned to the program. While our results also point to greater extension access and greater knowledge among female spouses in locations where both male and female spouses were targeted by the program, we do not find clear evidence that a more inclusive approach translates into higher uptake of the subject technologies. Finally, we find that the video-mediated approach becomes less costly as the scale of operation increases.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管在许多低收入国家，信息通信技术（ICT）在小农农业中的应用备受热情，但基于ICT的方法的有效性仍存在许多问题。本研究利用一项为期两年的随机实验数据，评估了视频中介的农业推广服务提供对埃塞俄比亚农民采用改良农业技术和方法的影响。我们的结果表明，视频中介的推广方法通过改善推广获取和农民知识，显著提高了推荐技术和方法的采用率。具体而言，我们发现，与政府的传统推广方法相比，视频中介的推广覆盖了更广泛的受众，并在随机分配到该计划的地点中，导致农民对相关技术的理解和采用水平更高。虽然我们的结果也表明，在男性和女性配偶均被计划针对的地点，女性配偶的推广获取和知识水平更高，但我们没有发现明确证据表明更具包容性的方法会转化为对相关技术更高的采用率。最后，我们发现，随着运营规模的扩大，视频中介的方法成本降低。

articles.title_en: Inventory credit to enhance food security in Burkina Faso
articles.title_cn: 布基纳法索的库存信贷以增强粮食安全
articles.abstract_en: In many African countries, rural households typically sell their crops immediately after the harvest, and then face severe food shortages during the lean season. This paper explores whether alleviating both credit and storage constraints through an inventory credit (or warrantage) program is associated with improvements in household livelihood. We partnered with a rural bank and a nation-wide organization of farmers to evaluate a warrantage program in seventeen villages in Burkina Faso. In randomly chosen treatment villages, households were offered a loan in exchange for storing a portion of their harvest as a physical collateral in one of the newly-built warehouses of the program. We found that the program has, on average, increased cultivated area in treated villages (mainly cotton and maize), fertilizer use, cattle and grain stock at the end of lean season (millet). Although much less robust, the results of the estimations concerning the direct users of the system further suggest that warrantage may have extended the self-subsistence period of about two weeks and increased dietary diversity, with more fruit consumed weekly.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多非洲国家，农村家庭通常在收获后立即出售作物，然后在淡季面临严重的粮食短缺。本文探讨了通过库存信贷（或担保仓储）计划同时缓解信贷和储存约束是否与家庭生计的改善相关。我们与一家农村银行和一个全国性的农民组织合作，在布基纳法索的十七个村庄评估了一项担保仓储计划。在随机选择的处理村中，家庭被提供贷款，条件是将部分收成作为实物抵押品储存在该计划新建的仓库之一。我们发现，该计划平均增加了处理村的种植面积（主要是棉花和玉米）、化肥使用量、牲畜存栏量以及淡季结束时的谷物库存（小米）。尽管稳健性较差，但关于系统直接使用者的估计结果进一步表明，担保仓储可能将自给自足期延长了约两周，并增加了饮食多样性，每周消费的水果更多。

articles.title_en: Of cooks, crooks and slum-dwellers: Exploring the lived experience of energy and mobility poverty in Mexico's informal settlements
articles.title_cn: 厨师、骗子与贫民窟居民：探索墨西哥非正规住区能源与出行贫困的生活体验
articles.abstract_en: So-called “slum-dwellers” living in informal settlements in Mexico City Metropolitan Area (MCMA) often confront poor health outcomes, face chronic accommodation insecurity and are frequent victims of social intolerance, discrimination and racism. In addition, they usually reside in living environments with precariously hazardous conditions that often lead to their well-being endangerment. Based on extensive original research with slum-dwellers from the MCMA including focus groups (N = 18 participants), household interviews (N = 51 participants), and site visits (N = 5), this study investigates their energy and housing needs, transport and mobility patterns and challenges to their overall quality of life and health. The MCMA is one of the largest metropolitan regions globally, and most of its inhabitants experience a “double energy vulnerability,” circumstances whereby people are at an intensified risk of energy and transport poverty simultaneously. Our investigation circles around three key themes. In exploring the subject of extreme poverty and vulnerability, we show not only the problems they confront but also illegal practices such as electricity thefts and coping strategies. In investigating the subject of perpetual peripheralization, we show troubling patterns of discrimination, racism and social intolerance. In exploring the subject of spatial justice, we suggest a set of policies that ought to help achieve it.
articles.abstract_cn: 居住在墨西哥城大都市区（MCMA）非正规住区的所谓“贫民窟居民”常常面临不良的健康结果、长期住宿不安全，并且经常成为社会不容忍、歧视和种族主义的受害者。此外，他们通常居住在有危险条件的居住环境中，这常常导致他们的福祉受到威胁。基于对MCMA贫民窟居民的广泛原始研究，包括焦点小组（N = 18名参与者）、家庭访谈（N = 51名参与者）和实地考察（N = 5次），本研究调查了他们的能源和住房需求、交通和出行模式以及对其整体生活质量和健康的挑战。MCMA是全球最大的大都市区之一，其大多数居民经历“双重能源脆弱性”，即人们同时面临能源贫困和交通贫困风险加剧的情况。我们的调查围绕三个关键主题展开。在探索极端贫困和脆弱性主题时，我们不仅展示了他们面临的问题，还展示了诸如窃电等非法行为和应对策略。在调查永久边缘化主题时，我们展示了令人不安的歧视、种族主义和社会不容忍模式。在探索空间正义主题时，我们提出了一套应当有助于实现空间正义的政策。

articles.title_en: Does professionalizing maintenance unlock demand for more reliable water supply? Experimental evidence from rural Uganda
articles.title_cn: 专业化维护能否释放对更可靠供水的需求？来自乌干达农村的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Professionalization is gaining prominence as a strategy to address the deficiencies in rural water supply reliability and financial sustainability in low- and middle-income countries that have persisted under community management policies. Yet there is little evidence regarding how much water users can and will pay for the higher reliability that professionalized services promise. What evidence exists largely relies on stated preference studies that do not confront water users with paying over time. We conducted a price experiment to measure effective demand (willingness and ability to pay) for a professional handpump maintenance and repair service among 113 water committees and 1,031 households representative of two districts in northern Uganda. We offered a one-year subscription using Becker-DeGroot-Marschak auctions with real money payments. The service largely delivered on its guarantee of fast repairs and satisfied most customers. Nonetheless, we found that just 4% of water committees paid any price for the full service period. None paid for more than one month at prices higher than our estimate of operating cost even though it represented less than 1% of annual household expenditure. Our findings contrast assertions from recent stated preference studies that increasing handpump reliability is a lynchpin to attracting higher payments from rural water users. Misaligned incentives that discourage water users, nonprofits and their donors, local governments, and political candidates from shifting to higher tariffs for maintenance seem to best explain why effective demand was low. Despite the low demand, we estimate that professionally maintaining the existing handpumps in the study districts would cost less in the long run than the de facto practice of letting these assets fail repeatedly and rehabilitating them. As Uganda and other countries embark on maintenance-oriented, post-community management rural water policies, funders, practitioners, and researchers will need to grapple with how to align institutional incentives for sustainable financing.
articles.abstract_cn: 专业化正日益成为解决低收入和中等收入国家农村供水可靠性和财务可持续性缺陷的战略，这些缺陷在社区管理政策下持续存在。然而，关于用水户能为专业化服务承诺的更高可靠性支付多少费用，以及是否愿意支付，证据甚少。现有证据主要依赖于陈述性偏好研究，这些研究并未让用水户面对随时间推移的支付问题。我们进行了一项价格实验，以衡量乌干达北部两个地区具有代表性的113个水委员会和1,031户家庭对专业手泵维护和维修服务的有效需求（支付意愿和能力）。我们使用贝克-德格鲁特-马尔沙克拍卖方式，以真实货币支付提供了一年期的订阅服务。该服务在很大程度上兑现了快速维修的承诺，并使大多数客户满意。尽管如此，我们发现仅有4%的水委员会为整个服务期支付了任何价格。在高于我们估计的运营成本的价格下，没有人支付超过一个月的费用，尽管这占家庭年支出的不到1%。我们的发现与近期陈述性偏好研究的断言形成对比，后者认为提高手泵可靠性是吸引农村用水户更高支付的关键。激励错位使得用水户、非营利组织及其捐助者、地方政府和政治候选人都不愿转向更高的维护关税，这似乎最能解释有效需求为何低迷。尽管需求低迷，我们估计，从长远来看，对研究地区现有手泵进行专业维护的成本将低于让这些资产反复失效并修复的实际做法。随着乌干达和其他国家开始以维护为导向的后社区管理农村供水政策，资助者、从业者和研究者将需要应对如何协调机构激励以实现可持续融资的问题。

articles.title_en: Child labor among farm households in Mozambique and the role of reciprocal adult labor
articles.title_cn: 莫桑比克农户家庭中的童工现象与成人互助劳动的作用
articles.abstract_en: We test the impact of a reciprocal adult labor program, Ajuda Mútua (AM), on child labor and schooling. AM was introduced into the province of Nampula in Mozambique, an area where farm production relies on child labor, potentially due to labor and financial market failures. Using difference in differences, we estimate that AM reduces child labor by eight percentage points. We argue that AM reduces child labor by providing low-cost adult labor and potentially increasing farm productivity. We benchmark the AM results against the impact of Village Saving and Loan Associations (VSLA) and AM and VSLA in combination (VAM). Neither VSLA nor VAM reduce child labor. If credit is used in a way that increases labor demand beyond what can be accommodated by AM labor, child labor may increase. We conclude that addressing labor market failures may be more successful at reducing child labor than addressing financial market failures. Results on schooling are mixed.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们检验了成人互助劳动项目“互助援助”（AM）对童工和就学的影响。AM在莫桑比克楠普拉省引入，该地区的农业生产依赖童工，这可能是由于劳动力和金融市场失灵所致。使用双重差分法，我们估计AM使童工减少了八个百分点。我们认为AM通过提供低成本的成人劳动并可能提高农业生产力来减少童工。我们将AM的结果与村庄储蓄贷款协会（VSLA）以及AM和VSLA组合（VAM）的影响进行了基准比较。VSLA和VAM均未减少童工。如果信贷的使用方式导致劳动需求增加超出AM劳动所能满足的范围，童工可能会增加。我们得出结论，解决劳动力市场失灵可能比解决金融市场失灵更能有效地减少童工。就学方面的结果好坏参半。

articles.title_en: The hidden cost of global economic integration: How foreign investment drives military expenditures
articles.title_cn: 全球经济一体化的隐性成本：外国投资如何推动军事支出
articles.abstract_en: The global economy is increasingly integrated, with more than 60,000 international firms now directing almost one million foreign affiliates worldwide. We examine one significant, and largely unexplored, aspect of this integration – the cost of protecting these global investments. More specifically, we assess the extent to which foreign direct investment (FDI) drives military expenditures. Drawing from recent studies, we adopt a social network framework. Using data from the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development’s Bilateral FDI Statistics and the International Monetary Fund’s Coordinated Direct Investment Survey, we construct the global FDI network between 2001 and 2017 and derive out-degree centrality scores based on each country’s structural location in this network. Next, using data from the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute, we estimate two-way fixed effects models for a global sample of 1,880 observations across 129 countries over this time period to assess the relationship between FDI centrality and military expenditures. We find that degree centrality in the global FDI network has a positive impact on military expenditures, net of other relevant predictors.Military expenditures do not, however, appear to drive FDI. We estimate the aggregate impact of FDI centrality on military expenditures, and suggest that these increased costs amount to a hidden subsidy of global corporate activity.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球经济日益一体化，目前有超过60,000家国际企业在全球范围内指导着近一百万家外国子公司。我们考察了这一体化中一个重要且很大程度上未被探索的方面——保护这些全球投资的成本。更具体地说，我们评估了外国直接投资（FDI）推动军事支出的程度。借鉴近期研究，我们采用社会网络框架。利用联合国贸易和发展会议的双边FDI统计以及国际货币基金组织的协调直接投资调查数据，我们构建了2001年至2017年间的全球FDI网络，并根据各国在该网络中的结构位置得出出度中心性得分。接下来，利用斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所的数据，我们对该时间段内覆盖129个国家的1,880个观测值的全球样本估计了双向固定效应模型，以评估FDI中心性与军事支出之间的关系。我们发现，在控制其他相关预测因素后，全球FDI网络中的度中心性对军事支出有正向影响。然而，军事支出似乎并不推动FDI。我们估计了FDI中心性对军事支出的总体影响，并认为这些增加的成本相当于对全球企业活动的隐性补贴。

articles.title_en: Bank deregulation and corporate environmental performance
articles.title_cn: 银行放松管制与企业环境绩效
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we provide one of the first pieces of evidence about how bank deregulation affects corporate environmental performance. We use a unique dataset that contains rich information on firms’ toxic emissions and exploit the bank branching deregulation policy in China. We find that bank deregulation significantly improves firms’ environmental performance, as measured by lower emission intensity of chemical oxygen demand (COD). We further demonstrate that these firms’ production efficiency increases and the ratio of tangible assets to total assets decreases, which suggests that upgrading technology and asset mix are the main channels. To improve the efficiency of the banking system, many developing countries are undergoing or moving toward bank deregulation. By focusing on corporate environmental performance, we document an important but unanticipated result of bank deregulation, and the results also provide policy implications for the burgeoning reform in green finance.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们提供了关于银行放松管制如何影响企业环境绩效的首批证据之一。我们使用了一个包含企业有毒排放丰富信息的独特数据集，并利用了中国银行分支机构放松管制政策。我们发现银行放松管制显著改善了企业的环境绩效，以化学需氧量（COD）排放强度降低为衡量标准。我们进一步证明，这些企业的生产效率提高，有形资产占总资产的比例下降，这表明技术升级和资产组合调整是主要渠道。为提高银行体系的效率，许多发展中国家正在经历或走向银行放松管制。通过关注企业环境绩效，我们记录了银行放松管制的一个重要但未预料到的结果，这些结果也为绿色金融的新兴改革提供了政策启示。

articles.title_en: Women’s work in India: Evidence from changes in time use between 1998 and 2019
articles.title_cn: 印度女性的工作：来自1998年至2019年时间使用变化的证据
articles.abstract_en: I provide evidence on long-run changes in women’s work for six Indian states common to the 1998–99 and 2019 time-use surveys. Rural women experienced large decreases in work time (especially paid work) but urban women did not. Men experienced larger declines in paid work but partly compensated with greater self-employment. Changes in self-reported “principal usual activity status” that are typically used to measure labour force participation do not provide an accurate measure of these changes in work time. Declining work for rural women is observed regardless of self-reported usual activity status, education level, caste/religious group, or state. Leisure time for women increased, reducing the gender-gap in leisure by 50%.
articles.abstract_cn: 我提供了关于印度六个邦女性工作长期变化的证据，这些邦在1998-99年和2019年的时间使用调查中均有覆盖。农村女性的工作时间大幅减少（尤其是有偿工作），但城市女性并非如此。男性的有偿工作下降幅度更大，但部分通过增加自雇来补偿。通常用于衡量劳动力参与率的自我报告“主要通常活动状态”的变化并不能准确反映这些工作时间的变化。无论自我报告的通常活动状态、教育水平、种姓/宗教群体或邦如何，农村女性工作时间的下降均被观察到。女性的闲暇时间增加，使闲暇时间中的性别差距缩小了50%。

articles.title_en: Identity and conflict: Evidence from Tuareg rebellion in Mali
articles.title_cn: 身份与冲突：来自马里图阿雷格叛乱的证据
articles.abstract_en: Does internal conflict erode national identity in Sub-Saharan Africa? We explore this question in the context of the 2012 Tuareg rebellion in Mali. The timing of the conflict was plausibly exogenous: the fall of al-Gaddafi’s regime in Libya in 2011 triggered the return of the Tuareg fighters from the demised leader’s Praetorian guard to their homeland in Northern Mali. Using representative survey data on the salience of national and ethnic identities, we perform a difference-in-differences estimation and find that the outbreak of the conflict prompted Malian residents living closer to the conflict zone to decrease their national identity more than the residents further away. We argue that this effect is likely to have been driven by proximity to violent events perpetrated by separatist groups and not by selective migration, exposure to internally displaced persons, communal violence, or other potential alternative explanations. Our results are consistent with the qualitative evidence on the matter. We place these findings in the context of recent theoretical advances in identity economics.
articles.abstract_cn: 内部冲突是否会削弱撒哈拉以南非洲的国家认同？我们在2012年马里图阿雷格叛乱的背景下探讨这一问题。冲突的时机似乎是外生的：2011年利比亚卡扎菲政权垮台，促使这位已故领导人的近卫军中的图阿雷格战士返回他们在马里北部的家园。利用关于国家和民族身份显著性的代表性调查数据，我们进行了双重差分估计，发现冲突的爆发使得居住在冲突区域附近的马里居民比远离冲突区域的居民更大幅度地降低了国家认同。我们认为，这一效应很可能由分离主义团体实施的暴力事件的距离所驱动，而非选择性迁移、接触境内流离失所者、社区暴力或其他潜在替代解释。我们的结果与关于此事的定性证据一致。我们将这些发现置于身份经济学近期理论进展的背景下。

articles.title_en: Women who do not migrate: Intersectionality, social relations, and participation in Western Nepal
articles.title_cn: 未迁移的女性：交叉性、社会关系与尼泊尔西部的参与
articles.abstract_en: Migration impacts left-behind populations, disrupting established norms of social interaction, participation, and inclusion. In western Nepal, labour migration is common among young men, with implications for household and community participation among those left behind, who are predominately women. In this study, we use mixed methods to examine how labour migration impacts the social inclusion of migrant households, especially, of left-behind women in community groups and activities. For our analysis, we use quantitative survey data from over 3600 households in the Karnali and Mahakali River Basins of western Nepal and qualitative data from 16 focus group discussions and 37 in-depth interviews held in the same region. Our analysis reveals substantial heterogeneity in the experiences of women and households left behind by migrants. Women’s opportunities to participate in economic systems such as natural resource user committees and non-governmental organisation trainings are moderated by intersecting identities including gender, caste/ethnicity, kinship, age, and economic status. Young women from nuclear, low caste, and poor households with limited social ties suffer from disadvantaged positions and face restricted access to spaces of participation. Accordingly, left-behind women’s opportunities to benefit from community resources remain dependent on their caste and kinship networks. These findings contribute to ongoing debates on the impacts of migration, and can help inform improved targeting of interventions to advance gender equity in rural Nepal.
articles.abstract_cn: 迁移影响留守人口，扰乱了既定的社会互动、参与和包容规范。在尼泊尔西部，年轻男性中普遍存在劳动力迁移，这对留守者（主要是女性）的家庭和社区参与产生了影响。在本研究中，我们采用混合方法考察劳动力迁移如何影响移民家庭的社会包容，特别是留守女性在社区团体和活动中的参与。我们的分析使用了来自尼泊尔西部卡尔纳利和马哈卡利河流域超过3600户家庭的定量调查数据，以及在同一地区进行的16次焦点小组讨论和37次深度访谈的定性数据。我们的分析揭示了移民留守女性和家庭经历的显著异质性。女性参与自然资源使用者委员会和非政府组织培训等经济体系的机会受到性别、种姓/民族、亲属关系、年龄和经济地位等交叉身份的影响。来自核心家庭、低种姓和贫困家庭且社会联系有限的年轻女性处于不利地位，参与空间受限。因此，留守女性从社区资源中获益的机会仍然取决于其种姓和亲属网络。这些发现为关于迁移影响的持续辩论做出了贡献，并有助于改进旨在促进尼泊尔农村性别平等的干预措施的目标定位。

articles.title_en: Strategizing actors and agents in the functioning of informal property Rights: The tragicomedy of the extralegal housing market in China
articles.title_cn: 非正式产权运作中的策略行动者与代理人：中国法外住房市场的悲喜剧
articles.abstract_en: This paper engages with the ongoing theoretical enquiry into the actual functioning and diverse practices of informal property rights. Departing from the prevailing neoliberal perspective and the credibility thesis, this paper develops a framework of institutional analysis to understand the functioning and regional variation of informal property rights. It takes the institutions-as-equilibria perspective and situates both structural and endogenous institutional variables in actors’ strategic choices. We test our conceptual framework through a multisite empirical study of extralegal and untitled housing in China. Building on game theory, archival research, and fieldwork, we compare the key variables contributing to the divergent fortunes of extralegal and untitled housing property rights in three Chinese cities: prospering in Shenzhen, selectively interfered with in Beijing, and eliminated in Sanya. The functioning of informal property rights is found to be contingent upon diverse strategic interactions of local governments and key local stakeholders. Our paper highlights the formation of local actors’ behavioral beliefs and their adjustment through a nonlinear feedback mechanism. It suggests the necessity and significance of integrating structural and endogenous institutional variables, elaborating on the interplay of formal and informal institutions, and applying the microeconomic and dynamic perspectives to better understand the functioning and diverse practices of informal property rights in the developing world.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文参与了对非正式产权实际运作和多样化实践的持续理论探讨。本文偏离主流的新自由主义视角和可信度论点，发展了一个制度分析框架，以理解非正式产权的运作和区域差异。本文采取制度即均衡的视角，将结构性和内生性制度变量置于行动者的策略选择中。我们通过对中国法外和无产权住房的多地点实证研究来检验我们的概念框架。基于博弈论、档案研究和田野调查，我们比较了导致中国三个城市法外和无产权住房产权命运不同的关键变量：在深圳繁荣，在北京受到选择性干预，在三亚被消除。研究发现，非正式产权的运作取决于地方政府和关键地方利益相关者的多样化策略互动。本文强调了地方行动者行为信念的形成及其通过非线性反馈机制的调整。本文提出，整合结构性和内生性制度变量、阐述正式与非正式制度的相互作用，以及应用微观经济和动态视角来更好地理解发展中世界非正式产权的运作和多样化实践，是必要且重要的。

articles.title_en: Educate the girls: Long run effects of secondary schooling for girls in Pakistan
articles.title_cn: 教育女孩：巴基斯坦女孩中等教育的长期影响
articles.abstract_en: In 2004, the government of Punjab, Pakistan introduced a conditional cash assistance program for girls attending secondary schools. We exploit variations in exposure to the program across cohorts and regions to estimate the long run effects of the program on women’s marriage and fertility decisions, maternal healthcare utilization and the health outcomes of their children. We find that each potential year of exposure to the program increases the probability of completing secondary school by 1.9 percent and decreases the probability of an early marriage by 3.5 percent. Exposure to the program also delays early childbirth and increases the likelihood of seeking prenatal care later in life. We also find evidence of inter-generational effects – children of women exposed to the program are less likely to be underweight (−1.7 percent) or stunted (−1.9 percent) than the comparison sample. Evidence suggests assortative matching in the marriage market, increased health awareness and empowerment of educated women may be among the potential drivers of these results. These findings imply that programs aimed at promoting girls’ education can lead to beneficial long run gains in multiple dimensions that should be factored in evaluating such policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 2004年，巴基斯坦旁遮普省政府为就读中学的女孩推出了一项有条件的现金援助计划。我们利用不同队列和地区对该计划接触程度的差异，来估计该计划对女性婚姻和生育决策、孕产妇保健利用及其子女健康结果的长期影响。我们发现，每增加一年潜在的计划接触时间，完成中学教育的概率提高1.9%，早婚的概率降低3.5%。接触该计划还推迟了早育，并增加了日后寻求产前保健的可能性。我们还发现了代际效应的证据——接触该计划的女性所生子女，与对照组样本相比，体重不足（−1.7%）或发育迟缓（−1.9%）的可能性更低。证据表明，婚姻市场中的同型匹配、健康意识的提高以及受教育女性的赋权可能是这些结果的潜在驱动因素。这些发现意味着，旨在促进女孩教育的计划可以在多个维度带来有益的长期收益，在评估此类政策时应予以考虑。

articles.title_en: Unlocking “lock-in” and path dependency: A review across disciplines and socio-environmental contexts
articles.title_cn: 解锁“锁定”与路径依赖：跨学科与社会-环境背景的综述
articles.abstract_en: Introduced in the early 2000s, the concept of carbon “lock-in” has been widely adopted by think tanks, academics, and civil society trying to break away from the consequences of fossil-fuel induced carbon emissions and climate change. The concept has been instrumental to energy economic policy, energy transitions, and automobile transportation and urban mobility. It has parallels with “path dependency” across sectors, including water governance, fisheries, farmer tenure, and debt. Yet its use has also fallen short in applying it to nontechnical settings beyond infrastructure. In this review article, we argue that the “lock-in” concept is relevant to a much broader range of multi-scalar socio-environmental challenges to development. We expand lock-in to consider granular issues that tend to slip out of macro-level technological and institutional path dependencies, without falling into the ‘naturalizing trap’ in systems thinking. Broadening and re-engaging the concept of lock-in strengthens our analytical ability to address a range of structurally uneven environmental and societal lock-ins.
articles.abstract_cn: 碳“锁定”概念于2000年代初引入，已被智囊团、学者和公民社会广泛采用，试图摆脱化石燃料导致的碳排放和气候变化的后果。该概念对能源经济政策、能源转型、汽车交通和城市出行具有重要作用。它与跨部门的“路径依赖”有相似之处，包括水治理、渔业、农民土地使用权和债务。然而，其应用在基础设施之外的非技术环境中也有所不足。在这篇综述文章中，我们认为“锁定”概念与更广泛的多尺度社会-环境发展挑战相关。我们扩展了锁定概念，以考虑那些往往从宏观技术和制度路径依赖中滑落的细粒度问题，同时避免陷入系统思维中的“自然化陷阱”。拓宽并重新参与锁定概念，增强了我们分析一系列结构性不平衡的环境和社会锁定的能力。

articles.title_en: Looking for advice: The politics of consulting services procurement in the World Bank
articles.title_cn: 寻求建议：世界银行咨询服务采购的政治
articles.abstract_en: Scholarship on development aid investigates how donors’ and recipients’ political and economic interests interact to weaken effectiveness of aid. These influences have been traced at various stages of the aid cycle – from aid commitment and disbursement to impact evaluation. Yet, development assistance programs provide not only financial resources for recipient countries, but also human capital. Specifically, development aid agencies often rely on experts’ and consulting firms’ knowledge to enable project development and implementation. Such knowledge can increase recipients’ capacity to implement domestic reforms, thereby spurring economic and social development. However, transfers of human capital may experience similar pressures that influence flows of financial capital and reduce their effectiveness. This article aims to investigate whether donors’ and recipients’ interests sway the flow of human capital provided through development programs. I focus on the procurement process for consulting services funded by World Bank development aid, and show that formal institutional requirements for consultant selection leave room for recipient governments to pursue domestic and foreign benefits from procurement decisions. In addition, my analyses show that governments’ pursuit of such benefits has tangible consequences for aid effectiveness: when recipients favor domestic consulting firms, projects take more time to complete and tend to receive lower outcome evaluations.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于发展援助的学术研究探讨了捐助者和受援国的政治和经济利益如何相互作用以削弱援助的有效性。这些影响已在援助周期的各个阶段被追溯——从援助承诺和支付到影响评估。然而，发展援助项目不仅为受援国提供财政资源，还提供人力资本。具体而言，发展援助机构通常依赖专家和咨询公司的知识来推动项目的制定和实施。这种知识可以增强受援国实施国内改革的能力，从而促进经济和社会发展。然而，人力资本的转移可能面临类似影响金融资本流动并降低其有效性的压力。本文旨在调查捐助者和受援国的利益是否会影响通过发展项目提供的人力资本的流动。我聚焦于世界银行发展援助资助的咨询服务采购过程，并表明顾问选择的正式制度要求为受援国政府留下了从采购决策中追求国内外利益的空间。此外，我的分析表明，政府追求此类利益对援助有效性产生了切实的后果：当受援国偏爱国内咨询公司时，项目完成所需时间更长，且往往获得较低的结果评估。

articles.title_en: Tangential Movements: How feminist organizing against gender-based violence offers an alternative avenue for protesting drug violence in Latin America
articles.title_cn: 切向运动：拉丁美洲女权主义反对性别暴力的组织如何为抗议毒品暴力提供替代途径
articles.abstract_en: In the last fifty years, Latin America witnessed both a stark rise in violence between drug trafficking organizations and militarized police forces, as well as a significant expansion of social movements. Few movements, however, have explicitly mobilized against drug violence due to the extreme dangers of speaking out against armed and corrupt actors. In this paper, we extend our understanding of social movements and drug violence by analyzing the relationship between feminist movements against gender-based violence—or feminist anti-violence (FAV)—and drug violence. We conceive FAV as a “tangential movement” to drug-related violence, mobilizing around its root causes and consequences without directly targeting its perpetrators. The paper examines case studies of feminist anti-violence movements in three cities: Ciudad Juárez, Mexico; Caracas, Venezuela; and Medellín, Colombia. We show that as feminist movements mobilize against gender-based violence, they provide an alternative, and safer, avenue for citizens to mobilize against drug-related violence by working to (a) curb intimate forms of abuse and trauma that create intergenerational cycles of violence; (b) decrease impunity by demanding the state hold perpetrators of violence accountable; (c) strengthen government institutions and their relations with civic organizations, thereby helping enforce democracy and human rights; (d) challenge patriarchal notions of violent masculinity; and (e) organize against structural inequality that bolsters participation in the drug trade. By considering how feminist anti-violence movements help address the underlying causes of drug violence, we can identify new pathways for organizing around human security in contexts where direct channels of confrontation are too risky.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去五十年中，拉丁美洲既见证了贩毒组织与军事化警察部队之间暴力的急剧上升，也见证了社会运动的显著扩展。然而，由于公开反对武装和腐败行为者极度危险，很少有运动明确动员反对毒品暴力。在本文中，我们通过分析女权主义反对性别暴力运动（即女权主义反暴力运动，FAV）与毒品暴力之间的关系，扩展了我们对社会运动和毒品暴力的理解。我们将FAV视为针对毒品相关暴力的“切向运动”，围绕其根本原因和后果进行动员，而不直接针对其 perpetrators。本文考察了三个城市的女权主义反暴力运动案例研究：墨西哥华雷斯城、委内瑞拉加拉加斯和哥伦比亚麦德林。我们表明，随着女权主义运动动员反对性别暴力，它们为公民动员反对毒品相关暴力提供了一条替代且更安全的途径，通过以下方式：（a）遏制造成代际暴力循环的亲密形式的虐待和创伤；（b）通过要求国家追究暴力肇事者的责任来减少有罪不罚；（c）加强政府机构及其与公民组织的关系，从而帮助维护民主和人权；（d）挑战暴力男性气质的父权观念；（e）组织反对助长参与毒品贸易的结构性不平等。通过考虑女权主义反暴力运动如何帮助解决毒品暴力的根本原因，我们可以在直接对抗渠道过于危险的背景下，确定围绕人类安全进行组织的新途径。

articles.title_en: Does economic growth reduce multidimensional poverty? Evidence from low- and middle-income countries
articles.title_cn: 经济增长是否减少了多维贫困？来自低收入和中等收入国家的证据
articles.abstract_en: The long-standing tradition of empirical studies investigating the nexus between economic growth and poverty concentrates mainly on monetary poverty. In contrast, little is known about the relationship between economic growth and multidimensional poverty. Consequently, this study seeks to assess the elasticity of multidimensional poverty to growth, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The study employs two novel, individual-based multidimensional poverty indices: the G-CSPI and the G-M0. It relies on an unbalanced panel dataset of 91 low- and middle-income countries observed between 1990 and 2018: this is thus far the largest sample and the longest time span used in the literature to address this research question. Within a regression framework, we estimate the growth elasticity of multidimensional poverty using the first difference estimator. Our study finds that the growth elasticity of multidimensional poverty is −0.46 while using the G-CSPI and −0.35 while using the G-M0: this means that a 10% increase in GDP decreases the multidimensional poverty by approximately 4–5%. There is, however, heterogeneity in the results; in particular, the elasticity is higher in the second sub-period (2001–2018) and for countries with lower initial levels of poverty. Furthermore, a comparative analysis reveals that the elasticity of income-poverty to growth is five to eight times higher than that of multidimensional poverty. In conclusion, our results indicate that economic growth is an important instrument to alleviate multidimensional poverty, but its effect is substantially lower than that on monetary poverty. Therefore, future research should identify other factors and policies, such as social policies, to substantially reduce multidimensional poverty.
articles.abstract_cn: 长期以来，研究经济增长与贫困之间关系的实证研究传统主要集中在货币贫困上。相比之下，关于经济增长与多维贫困之间关系的了解甚少。因此，本研究旨在评估多维贫困对增长的弹性，特别是在低收入和中等收入国家。研究采用了两个新颖的、基于个体的多维贫困指数：G-CSPI和G-M0。研究依赖于1990年至2018年间91个低收入和中等收入国家的不平衡面板数据集：这是迄今为止文献中用于解决这一研究问题的最大的样本和最长的时期。在回归框架内，我们使用一阶差分估计量来估计多维贫困的增长弹性。我们的研究发现，使用G-CSPI时，多维贫困的增长弹性为-0.46，而使用G-M0时为-0.35：这意味着GDP每增加10%，多维贫困大约减少4-5%。然而，结果存在异质性；特别是，在第二个子时期（2001-2018年）以及初始贫困水平较低的国家，弹性更高。此外，比较分析显示，收入贫困对增长的弹性比多维贫困高五到八倍。总之，我们的结果表明，经济增长是减轻多维贫困的重要工具，但其效果远低于对货币贫困的效果。因此，未来的研究应确定其他因素和政策，如社会政策，以大幅减少多维贫困。

articles.title_en: Protein pluralism and food systems transition: A review of sustainable protein meta-narratives
articles.title_cn: 蛋白质多元主义与食品系统转型：可持续蛋白质元叙事综述
articles.abstract_en: There is a very quickly growing literature regarding the appropriate role of protein foods in sustainable food systems transition. From this literature there has emerged several points of contention and debate. There is, for instance, contestation over the appropriate balance of plant- and animal- sourced protein foods in feeding the world’s growing population; competing interpretations of the contributions made by plant and animal protein foods to healthy diets and the alleviation of malnutrition; disputes over the welfare of animals and human workers in protein production, as well as over the ethics of genetic manipulation in the production of novel protein food products; environmental debates about the relationships between protein food production methods and climate change and biodiversity decline; and finally (though not exhaustively), disagreements about how various populations, economic sectors, and cultural practices could be impacted by disruptive alternative protein food technologies or new protein-oriented policies introduced in the name of fomenting a sustainable agri-food transition. Protein foods are thus deeply implicated in a range of debates about sustainable agri-food systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于蛋白质食品在可持续食品系统转型中的适当作用，相关文献正在迅速增长。从这些文献中出现了几个争论和辩论的焦点。例如，在养活世界日益增长的人口中，植物源和动物源蛋白质食品的适当平衡存在争议；对植物和动物蛋白质食品对健康饮食和减轻营养不良的贡献存在相互竞争的解释；关于蛋白质生产中动物和人类工人的福利，以及在新颖蛋白质食品生产中基因操作的伦理问题存在争议；关于蛋白质食品生产方法与气候变化和生物多样性丧失之间关系的环境辩论；最后（尽管并非详尽无遗），关于各种人群、经济部门和文化实践可能受到以促进可持续农业食品转型为名引入的颠覆性替代蛋白质食品技术或新的蛋白质导向政策的影响，存在分歧。因此，蛋白质食品深深卷入了一系列关于可持续农业食品系统的辩论中。

articles.title_en: Hospitalization due to fire-induced pollution in the Brazilian Amazon: A causal inference analysis with an assessment of policy trade-offs
articles.title_cn: 巴西亚马孙火灾污染导致的住院：因果推断分析与政策权衡评估
articles.abstract_en: Developing countries by relying on agricultural fires trade respiratory health for cheaper land preparation and greater food security of subsistence farmers. In the Brazilian Amazon, thousands of kilometres of vegetation are annually burned, releasing pollutants that impact the health of 24 million inhabitants. The paper seeks to fill two crucial informational gaps for policy planning, namely, the size of the impact on the most pollution-susceptible groups, i.e., children and the elderly, and the priority locations for health-oriented intervention on fires. A municipal-monthly panel covering ten years of the Amazonian territory was analysed by relying on exogenous and high-resolution wind direction variation to identify the effect of fires on pollution and hospitalizations. This is an unparalleled effort for applying to a large geographical area spanning five million km2 a highly refined identification strategy relying on hourly gridded wind and fire data. As the result, one extra standard deviation of “upwind” fires was estimated to increase asthma-related hospitalization of the elderly in 0.03 days/month, that is, 4 % of the bed-days commonly demanded by such kind of hospitalization, an effect whose size decayed with the distance between fires and hospitals. A policy assessment uncovered the trade-off between respiratory health of the elderly and nutritional health of fire-dependent subsistence farmers, presenting a priority map for tackling the issue with municipal-level interventions. The targeting of non-subsistence fires is advised, what could avoid 28 days of hospitalization per year. It is thus demonstrated that the trade-offs inherent to agricultural fires could be better balanced by evidence-based targeting of fire prevention policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 发展中国家依赖农业火灾，以呼吸健康换取更廉价的土地准备和自给农民更高的粮食安全。在巴西亚马孙地区，每年有数千平方公里的植被被焚烧，释放的污染物影响24万居民的健康。本文旨在填补政策规划的两个关键信息空白，即对最易受污染群体（即儿童和老年人）的影响程度，以及针对火灾的健康导向干预的优先地点。通过利用外生且高分辨率的风向变化来识别火灾对污染和住院的影响，分析了覆盖亚马孙地区十年的市级月度面板数据。这是将精细识别策略应用于覆盖五百万平方公里的大地理区域的空前努力，该策略依赖于每小时网格化的风和火灾数据。结果显示，上风向火灾每增加一个标准差，估计会使老年人哮喘相关住院增加0.03天/月，即占此类住院通常所需床位日的4%，且该效应的大小随火灾与医院之间的距离增加而衰减。政策评估揭示了老年人呼吸健康与依赖火灾的自给农民营养健康之间的权衡，并提出了通过市级干预解决该问题的优先地图。建议针对非自给性火灾进行干预，每年可避免28天的住院。因此，研究表明，通过基于证据的火灾预防政策目标定位，可以更好地平衡农业火灾固有的权衡。

articles.title_en: Is China forest landscape restoration (FLR) worth it? A cost-benefit analysis and non-equilibrium ecological view
articles.title_cn: 中国森林景观恢复（FLR）是否值得？成本效益分析与非平衡生态学视角
articles.abstract_en: Forest Landscape Restoration (FLR) is an important way to address the problems of climate change and land desertification. However, there has been significant controversy about the high cost of restoration and whether it is economically feasible. Most cost-benefit analyses of ecological restoration plans have focused on a single ecosystem, without considering the complexity and relevance of the ecosystem. These studies have also not considered the large number of potential important benefits and real opportunity costs, creating the possibility of bias in the cost-benefit analysis. This study applies theoretical analysis tools from non-equilibrium ecology, combining a land system change model and economic analysis to conduct a comprehensive cost-benefit analysis of China's FLR program. The research results show that: (1) The benefits of China's implementation of the FLR policy exceed the costs, with positive net benefits. (2) After fully considering the cost of FLR, including the true opportunity cost, the net benefit of forest landscape restoration in China is between 60 trillion yuan and 110 trillion yuan. (3) Different types of commitment goals impact the success of the recovery plan. Specifically, quantifiable targets better support successful FLR implementation. The article concludes that it is worthwhile to implement forest landscape restoration in China, although the profit margin of the ecological plan is smaller than generally thought. The results provide a scientific basis for the government to formulate FLR policies and other ecological restoration plans.
articles.abstract_cn: 森林景观恢复（FLR）是应对气候变化和土地荒漠化问题的重要途径。然而，关于恢复的高成本及其经济可行性一直存在重大争议。大多数生态恢复计划的成本效益分析都集中在单一生态系统上，没有考虑生态系统的复杂性和相关性。这些研究也没有考虑大量潜在的重要效益和真实的机会成本，从而可能导致成本效益分析存在偏差。本研究运用非平衡生态学的理论分析工具，结合土地系统变化模型和经济分析，对中国FLR计划进行了全面的成本效益分析。研究结果表明：（1）中国实施FLR政策的效益超过成本，具有正净效益。（2）在充分考虑FLR成本（包括真实机会成本）后，中国森林景观恢复的净效益在60万亿元至110万亿元之间。（3）不同类型的承诺目标影响恢复计划的成功。具体而言，可量化的目标更能支持FLR的成功实施。文章得出结论，在中国实施森林景观恢复是值得的，尽管生态计划的利润率比普遍认为的要小。研究结果为政府制定FLR政策和其他生态恢复计划提供了科学依据。

articles.title_en: Did a successful fight against COVID-19 come at a cost? Impacts of the pandemic on employment outcomes in Vietnam
articles.title_cn: 成功抗击COVID-19是否付出了代价？疫情对越南就业结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: Despite its low middle-income status, Vietnam has been widely praised for its success in the fight against early waves of the COVID-19 pandemic, with a low mortality rate of approximately 100 deaths out of a population of less than 100 million by the end of 2020. We add to the emerging literature on COVID-19 effects on the labor market for poorer countries by analyzing rich individual-level data from Vietnam’s Labor Force Surveys spanning 2015 to 2020. We find post-pandemic increases in unemployment and temporary layoff rates alongside decreases in employment quality. Monthly wages declined even as the proportion of workers receiving below-minimum wages substantially increased, contributing to sharply rising wage inequality. Our findings suggest that more resources should be allocated to protect vulnerable workers, especially as the pandemic continues to cause increasingly severe damage to the global economy.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管越南属于中低收入国家，但其在抗击COVID-19疫情早期浪潮中的成功广受赞誉，截至100年底，在不到100亿的人口中，死亡率约为2020例。我们通过分析越南劳动力调查中19年至2015年的丰富个体层面数据，为关于COVID-2020对较贫困国家劳动力市场影响的新兴文献做出贡献。我们发现疫情后失业率和临时裁员率上升，同时就业质量下降。月工资下降，而领取低于最低工资的工人比例大幅增加，导致工资不平等急剧上升。我们的研究结果表明，应分配更多资源来保护弱势工人，尤其是在疫情继续对全球经济造成日益严重损害的情况下。

articles.title_en: Healthcare reform and gender specific infant mortality in rural Nepal
articles.title_cn: 医疗改革与尼泊尔农村地区性别特异性婴儿死亡率
articles.abstract_en: We estimate to what extent a large scale health care reform disproportionately affects the mortality rate of boys in the context of a developing country with cultural preferences favoring boys. We use arguably exogenous variations due to a health care reform—the National Health Policy—which was implemented in Nepal in 1991 along with data from the Nepal Living Standard Survey 1996 and estimate that improved quality of primary health care facilities (by one standard deviation) reduces the mortality rate of infant boys by 3.43 percentage points but does not affect the mortality rate of infant girls. Our analysis points to societal gender preferences for sons and the consequent neglect of daughters’ health as potential drivers of some of the observed differences in mortality between genders and highlights the important role of cultural norms in shaping the outcomes of large scale health care reforms.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估计在具有偏爱男孩文化偏好的发展中国家背景下，大规模医疗改革在多大程度上不成比例地影响男孩的死亡率。我们利用因医疗改革——国家卫生政策——而产生的看似外生的变异，该政策于1991年在尼泊尔实施，并结合尼泊尔生活水平调查1996年的数据，估计初级卫生保健设施质量的提高（按一个标准差计）使男婴死亡率降低3.43个百分点，但不影响女婴死亡率。我们的分析指出，社会对儿子的性别偏好及由此导致的女儿健康忽视，是观察到的性别间死亡率差异的部分潜在驱动因素，并强调了文化规范在塑造大规模医疗改革结果中的重要作用。

articles.title_en: Adaptation to expected and unexpected weather fluctuations: Evidence from Bangladeshi smallholder farmers
articles.title_cn: 对预期和非预期天气波动的适应：来自孟加拉国小农的证据
articles.abstract_en: Whether and how quickly farmers adapt to a changing climate is of paramount importance to understanding the potential impacts of climate change on agriculture. Yet the literature on adaptation has paid less attention to the distinction between ex-ante adjustments to expected weather and ex-post responses to unexpected shocks. Using a three-wave, nationally representative Bangladesh Integrated Household Survey, this paper exploits large variation in precipitation and temperature to estimate the weather impacts on Bangladesh agriculture and to identify the associated productive adaptations to expected and unexpected weather changes. It presents evidence that Bangladeshi farmers are resilient to exposure of crops to temperatures below 32°C through various adaptive activities such as reallocation of land and irrigation water between rice and non-rice crops, the adoption of non-rice improved seed varieties, and the adjustment of the input cost composition. But increased exposure to extreme heat above 32°C causes significant declines in agricultural productivity in wet seasons. Although farmers increase irrigation water inputs to aus and aman rice against unexpected extreme heat, the adaptation effect remains limited. The total cash cost associated with cultivation does not respond to weather changes, plausibly due to the presence of financial liquidity constraints. This study’s finding adds to evidence of smallholder farmers’ short- and medium-run productive responses to adverse climate change in the developing world.
articles.abstract_cn: 农民是否以及多快地适应气候变化，对于理解气候变化对农业的潜在影响至关重要。然而，关于适应的文献较少关注对预期天气的事前调整与对非预期冲击的事后反应之间的区别。利用三轮全国代表性的孟加拉国综合住户调查，本文利用降水和温度的巨大变化来估计天气对孟加拉国农业的影响，并识别对预期和非预期天气变化的相关生产性适应。本文提供的证据表明，孟加拉国农民通过多种适应性活动，如在水稻和非水稻作物之间重新分配土地和灌溉水、采用非水稻改良种子品种以及调整投入成本构成，能够抵御作物暴露于低于32°C的温度。但暴露于高于32°C的极端高温会导致湿季农业生产率显著下降。尽管农民增加对夏稻和秋稻的灌溉水投入以应对非预期的极端高温，但适应效果仍然有限。与耕作相关的总现金成本对天气变化没有反应，这可能是由于存在金融流动性约束。本研究的发现补充了发展中国家小农对不利气候变化的短期和中期生产性反应的证据。

articles.title_en: Unravelling the ‘race to the bottom’ argument: Foreign direct investment and different types of labour rights
articles.title_cn: 解析“竞次”论点：外国直接投资与不同类型的劳工权利
articles.abstract_en: Does foreign direct investment (FDI) lead to better or worse labour standards in developing countries? We argue that it depends on the type of labour right, and how costly it is to protect it. We propose that governments are likely to follow international pressure and ‘climb to the top’ of improved labour standards, but only for those rights that do not incur direct costs to foreign investors, such as collective bargaining rights. In contrast, we expect that governments engage in a ’race to the bottom’ when it comes to rights that bear immediate costs for firms, such as overtime pay. To test our argument, we use novel data to distinguish between the legal protection of (1) fair working contracts, (2) adequate working time, (3) dismissal protections, which are more costly; versus (4) collective worker representation, and (5) industrial action rights, which are relatively cheaper to grant. Our panel data analysis for 75 developing countries (1982–2010) shows that higher FDI stock and flow is indeed connected to better protection of collective rights, while FDI flow is connected to a decline in relatively expensive outcome rights. These results remain robust across a range of model specifications.
articles.abstract_cn: 外国直接投资（FDI）是否会导致发展中国家的劳工标准提高或降低？我们认为这取决于劳工权利的类型以及保护这些权利的成本。我们提出，政府可能会遵循国际压力并“竞优”提高劳工标准，但仅限于那些不会给外国投资者带来直接成本的权利，如集体谈判权。相反，我们预期政府在涉及企业即时成本的权利（如加班费）方面会进行“竞次”。为检验我们的论点，我们使用新数据来区分法律保护中的（1）公平工作合同、（2）适当工作时间、（3）解雇保护（这些成本较高）与（4）集体工人代表权、（5）工业行动权（这些授予成本相对较低）。我们对75个发展中国家（1982-2010年）的面板数据分析表明，较高的FDI存量和流量确实与集体权利的更好保护相关，而FDI流量与相对昂贵的成果权利的下降相关。这些结果在一系列模型设定中保持稳健。

articles.title_en: Household welfare in the digital age: Assessing the effect of mobile money on household consumption volatility in developing countries
articles.title_cn: 数字时代的家庭福利：评估移动货币对发展中国家家庭消费波动性的影响
articles.abstract_en: Based on a sample of 76 developing countries over 1990–2019, we assess the effect of adopting mobile money on consumption volatility using entropy balancing. We reveal that countries with mobile money exhibit lower consumption volatility. After checking the robustness of this result, we show that the key drivers of mobile money’s stabilizing effect are financial inclusion and migrant remittances. Heterogeneity tests conducted indicate the sensitivity of the result to time and type of mobile money and to some structural factors, including trade openness, inflation, rural population, the rule of law, and level of development.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于1990-2019年间76个发展中国家的样本，我们使用熵平衡方法评估了采用移动货币对消费波动性的影响。我们发现，采用移动货币的国家表现出较低的消费波动性。在检验了这一结果的稳健性之后，我们表明移动货币稳定效应的关键驱动因素是金融包容性和移民汇款。进行的异质性检验表明，结果对时间和移动货币类型以及一些结构性因素（包括贸易开放度、通货膨胀、农村人口、法治和发展水平）具有敏感性。
